site_name: Amazon Tanner Way campus (IAD-100), 10321 Tanner Way, Manassas VA 20110
verification: No page I opened states when the first Tanner Way building opened or began operating. The cited Prince William Times article (Oct 23, 2023) says residents began hearing noise about 18 months earlier, complained to police on May 16, 2022, and calls the data centers "just-built" at that time. That shows cooling equipment was running by spring 2022, but the article does not say whether this was commissioning or live operation, and "just-built" as of May 2022 is consistent with a first building finished in either 2021 or 2022. 2022 is therefore an inferred upper bound, not a supported start year. The second article (Aug 17, 2026, updated Aug 25, 2026) mentions "four Amazon data centers on Tanner Way" only in passing; its line "Four nearby Amazon data centers, built three years ago, still do not appear to have full power" does not name a location and, in context, most likely refers to the separate four Amazon buildings on John Marshall Highway next to the Hillwood site (my inference from the article's layout, not stated in the text), so it should not be used to date Tanner Way. Pages that were unavailable: the Virginia DEQ data-center air-permit page returned 403, the Prince William Times site search returned 429 twice, and Data Center Dynamics returned 403, so I could not check a permit record or 2021-2022 coverage. A DEQ permit record or a 2021-2022 local article for 10321 Tanner Way would be the next thing to try.

lead.year_evidence_quote: the screech, hum and roar coming from the just-built data centers 600 feet to the north
lead.notes: A Prince William Times article (Oct 23, 2023) describes noise complaints from 'just-built' Amazon data centers on Tanner Way off Godwin Drive. Residents have measured the noise since May 2022, so the campus was running equipment by then. The year is an upper bound inferred from that noise, not an opening statement, and the first building may have started in 2021. A search-result snippet ties 10321 Tanner Way to IAD-100 under a DEQ permit, but the DEQ page returned 403 and the address match is unverified. An Aug 2026 PW Times article says four Tanner Way Amazon data centers were 'built three years ago', which sits loosely with 2022.
